shortDescription: A wallet on Aster DEX opened a 15x leveraged long position on 2.15 million ENA and is currently showing a profit of $310,700, with a return of 786.54%. According to Odaily, ENA reached a high of 0.28 USDT today and was trading at 0.273 USDT, up more than 23% over the past 24 hours.
